intended_behavior: Update the model matching logic in configure_model_settings to properly match vertex_ai/claude models that use '@' before the build identifier, either by normalizing the model string (e.g., replacing '@' with '-') or by extending the substring matching logic to recognize vertex_ai/claude naming conventions with '@'. This ensures these models do not fall back to whole-file editing and their appropriate settings are applied, while preserving current behavior for other model matches.

Add appropriate ModelSettings entries to MODEL_SETTINGS for vertex_ai/claude models (including those with '@' build identifiers or use a consistent naming scheme) so that these models have explicit configuration in the system. This allows proper feature support and prevents fallback to whole-file edits. This should also maintain compatibility with existing models.
